title: [CLM-4] "Cannot hijack the chain" depends on an ordering the spec does not require
description: Review finding CLM-4: "Cannot hijack the chain" depends on an ordering the spec does not require (lens CLM). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:204; spec/04-access-control.md:88; spec/03-spaces.md:28; PROPOSAL.md:80-81; PRFAQ.md:99. Fix: The gap is wider than the finding says. (1) The gate is "a DID it authenticates as a current member of the channel under Space state", but 03:28 says "Space membership does not imply channel membership" and a Kick (04:88) "removes a member from one or more channel MLS groups without a space-level ban" and changes no Space state, so a kicked member always passes the gate. (2) The service countersigns "at most one announcement per chain and `epoch`" and cannot check that the announced key matches a real Commit, so any current member, not only one being removed, can grab the single countersignature with a key only they hold and lock out the channel. Option (a) as originally proposed (Space-state removal first) covers neither case. This attacks the implementation, not decision Q1, which says the countersignature "closes removed-member forgery race". Until it is fixed, soften PROPOSAL l.80-81 and PRFAQ l.99. Add to agora-pozi.8 (open) scope, which already lists "commit ordering". Full text: notes/review/CLM-verified.md and notes/review/CLM.md.
